title: G2 Production Closure
intent: Close the production G2 exit gate with one real, UI-operable, recoverable GitHub-to-Acceptance delivery loop and reconcile the inherited G1/G2 delivery truth before claiming the milestone complete.
scope: Complete the remaining G2 domain, orchestration, product UI, connector, recovery, and evidence obligations needed to demonstrate the signature delivery loop with authenticated principals and a real GitHub effect. One human Outcome Owner may perform the separately recorded review, action-approval, and acceptance decisions when the Submission and ActionRequest are authored by authorized agent or service principals. The target also closes prerequisite G1 creation-entry gaps that prevent an honest G2 production claim.
non_goals: Broad G3 Go replatforming or mechanical translation of mature TypeScript compatibility services
Production admission of CubeSandbox, Private Runner, Cloud fleet, SSO, SCIM, billing, or regional control cells
Support for more than one enterprise channel or more than the GitHub SCM connector
Destructive contract migration before legacy-path usage is measured at zero and rollback is rehearsed
Merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without independent review and explicit Outcome Owner acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Delivery truth reconciled: G1 and G2 delivery records, reviews, evidence links, and statuses agree with repository and runtime facts; missing evidence is explicit
Real creation entry points: Web Chat and one enterprise channel connector preserve ordinary conversation and complete explicit Draft confirmation into the same versioned Target contract

Pinned agent execution: a real Codex execution binds AgentVersion, DeploymentRevision, GraphRevision, TargetRevision, RunAttempt, environment identity, logs, cost, and permissions, and produces a content-addressed code artifact

Durable graph orchestration: TargetWorkflow actively coordinates ready-node activation, child RunWorkflows, activities, timers, retry, cancellation, gates, and Continue-As-New while PostgreSQL remains authoritative

Complete work result contracts: IntegrationAttempt and HumanWorkResult are persisted and version-bound; IntegrationRun binds connector version, connection, graph revision, commit, criterion, and provider receipt

Independent assurance and acceptance: independent CI produces Evidence and VerificationResult for the fixed commit and criteria; a distinct reviewer approves the immutable Submission and the Outcome Owner records Acceptance

Safe real GitHub effect: short-lived GitHub credentials are resolved without disclosure; an approved pull-request action is created exactly once and records an EffectReceipt, including timeout and UnknownEffect reconciliation
Invalidation enforced: changing TargetRevision, Submission, artifact content, verification inputs, or action parameters invalidates prior decisions and prevents stale external effects

Product UI closes the loop: Target Workbench and Attention expose required create, retry, cancel, submit, review, accept, approve, execute, error, and recovery states without manual API or database intervention

Failure recovery proven: API, Temporal worker, runner, and provider fault demonstrations converge without manual database repair, stale attempts cannot overwrite newer attempts, and external effects are not duplicated

Release gate green: targeted tests, Go tests, workspace typecheck, full Vitest, production build, replay and rollback checks, browser acceptance, independent review, and Outcome Owner acceptance pass with inspectable evidence

github_test_effect.value: iiwish/verrail dedicated test branch and one test pull request
github_test_effect.constraint: No merge or release. Product Review, ActionApproval and Acceptance remain explicit human commands.

github_credential_boundary.constraint: The short-lived credential may cross only the authenticated internal request boundary and must never be persisted or logged

enterprise_channel.constraint: G2.7 implements one Feishu group or direct-message creation path through the shared channel connector contract

human_identity_model.constraint: Review, action approval, and acceptance remain separate commands and authorities; no fake human accounts or impersonation satisfy production evidence

blockers: Technical work owned by Codex under explicit user delegation: Director v2 has genuine bounded machine EvaluationRun b706d06e-5080-4c92-b0c9-c8b0441a53f9 (8/8 fixed governance smoke cases, cost unknown). T029 pins local cwd to immutable DeploymentRevision and validates trusted native wake binding. New graph/run proof remains outstanding. No human technical configuration is required; final Review, ActionApproval and Acceptance remain human decisions.

Full Vitest failed: general-server (4753 tests) and UI (4449 tests) passed; two CLI large-archive tests exceeded 5000 ms. The 16-test CLI fixture passed focused replay. Workspaces-b and 146 serialized server suites were not reached. No broad green result is claimed.
T023 and T024 real Feishu ingress, reply and same-draft Web confirmation passed; these are creation-flow evidence, not final G2 Acceptance.
T010 still requires real provider receipts, native delivery facts, independent review, and explicit human decisions.
